blocks.content: Introduction to Fire safety basics (no extinguisher classes)
Prevention + basic extinguisher readiness awareness + first actions (notify/follow local procedure).

items.definition: To verify a fire extinguisher is ready: (1) pressure gauge in green zone, (2) safety pin intact with tamper seal, (3) no visible damage to body or hose, (4) annual inspection tag current.
items.analogy: Like a pre-flight walkaround — you check each item methodically so that when you need it, it works.

blocks.question: Which combination of checks confirms a fire extinguisher is ready for service in a GA avionics shop?
choices: Verify the nozzle is unobstructed and the gauge reads any positive pressure
Weigh it to confirm charge weight only
Shake it to verify agent is loose inside
Pressure gauge in green, safety pin intact, no damage, annual tag current
blocks.feedback: All four checks are required: gauge in green zone, intact pin/seal, no physical damage, and a current annual inspection tag — all must pass for the extinguisher to be considered serviceable.
